questions.stem_text: When an appeal is made to the Supreme Court, the court usually

options.C: orders the lower court to retry the case
options.D: rules in favor of the defendant

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - refuses to hear the appeal

questions.stem_text: Federalism is a principle of government in which

options.A: power is shared between the national government and state governments
options.B: states have equal representation in the national government
options.C: individual liberties are guaranteed by a Bill of Rights
options.D: legislative, executive, and judicial powers are separated

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - power is shared between the national government and state governments

options.D: They flourished during periods of widespread dissatisfaction.
